I-001.name: IntentDrivenEngineeringFramework
I-001.description: Define VIBE as a standalone methodology for intent-driven engineering with graph-first continuity and governed execution.

export-frameworkIdentity.PURPOSE: Expose the core story of VIBE.

F-001.name: GraphFirstKnowledgeSystem
F-001.description: Use the knowledge graph as the primary knowledge spine and project clarified intent into the remaining canonical artifacts through deterministic, idempotent projection rules.

export-projectionModel.PURPOSE: Explain how graph state projects into requirements, plan, verification, and decisions.

F-002.name: MacroLanguage
F-002.description: Expose discover, refine, deliver, fix, sync, resume, deploy, vibe, and calibrate as the public workflow language with deterministic routing and explicit state transitions.

export-publicMacros.PURPOSE: Provide the stable user-facing API of VIBE.

F-003.name: OptionalBootstrapProduct
F-003.description: Describe vibestart as an optional product that installs and adapts VIBE through explicit core and deep product profiles, onboarding, and a deterministic first-run contract.

export-bootstrapProfiles.PURPOSE: Expose core and deep as product bootstrap profiles.

export-firstRunContract.PURPOSE: Expose the deterministic onboarding and first-run contract.

W-001.name: DefineMacroContracts
W-001.summary: Translate framework principles into stable macro state machines, deterministic routing, and an internal skill layer.

W-002.name: DefineAdaptiveGovernance
W-002.summary: Convert review, sync, drift, and calibration ideas into deterministic governance algebra with split sync semantics.

W-003.name: ConservativeRuntimeGuards
W-003.summary: Keep guided and single as normative defaults while treating auto, multi, and calibrate apply as experimental until stronger guards exist.

M-001.name: FrameworkIdentity
M-001.description: Identity, principles, value proposition, and optional product boundary.

export-identity.PURPOSE: Explain what VIBE is and what vibestart is not.

M-002.name: KnowledgeOntology
M-002.description: Graph-first ontology, lifecycle stages, and the semantic invariants that constrain projection.

export-ontology.PURPOSE: Expose node types, stages, and edges.

M-003.name: MacroContracts
M-003.description: Public macro contracts, executable routing and projection controls, and the private skill layer that realizes them.

export-macroContracts.PURPOSE: Define the stable public workflow API.

M-004.name: GovernancePolicy
M-004.description: Adaptive governance rules, review escalation, sync triggers, and policy calibration hooks.

export-governance.PURPOSE: Define review and sync behavior from risk signals.

M-005.name: ConfigurationSurface
M-005.description: Boundary between root manifest, docs-level policy config, and runtime state.

export-configBoundary.PURPOSE: Explain where active config, detailed policy, and runtime exhaust live.

M-006.name: BootstrapProfiles
M-006.description: Explicit core and deep bootstrap profiles, onboarding flow, and first-run contract for vibestart.

export-firstRunContract.PURPOSE: Expose the deterministic onboarding and first-run contract.

W-004.name: DefineBootstrapProductContract
W-004.summary: Translate the framework into an explicit vibestart core/deep product contract with onboarding and first-run behavior.

V-001.name: VerificationSurface
V-001.description: The project-wide verification surface that certifies artifact coherence and policy consistency.

export-phaseGates.PURPOSE: Define what must be true before the framework moves forward.

DEP-001.name: DeployMacroSurface
DEP-001.description: First-class deployment macro surface for local or quick-cloud deployment guidance.

export-deployMacro.PURPOSE: Reserve deploy as a first-class workflow surface.

D-001.name: StandaloneMethodologyOptionalProduct
D-001.description: VIBE is the methodology; vibestart is optional bootstrap/runtime.

D-002.name: GraphFirstCanonicalModel
D-002.description: knowledge-graph.xml is primary; docs/specs side-bridge is rejected.

D-003.name: ConfigBoundary
D-003.description: vibe.toml is root manifest, docs/vibe holds detailed policy, and .vibestart/state holds runtime exhaust.

export-configDecision.PURPOSE: Protect readable configuration and isolate runtime state.

D-004.name: MacroFirstPublicApi
D-004.description: Macros are the public workflow language; skills remain lower-level implementation operators.

D-005.name: ImplicitVibeDefault
D-005.description: Implicit vibe is enabled by default, while guided and single remain the safer starting defaults.

export-routingDecision.PURPOSE: Preserve the default routing and safe defaults.

D-006.name: RiskAndEvidenceGovernance
D-006.description: Adaptive governance is driven by risk and evidence rather than elapsed time, with explicit calibration hooks.

export-governanceDecision.PURPOSE: Preserve the policy basis and calibration model.

D-007.name: DeterministicKernelFirst
D-007.description: Prioritize deterministic routing, projection, and governance algebra before expanding autonomous runtime behavior.

D-008.name: FormalProjectionAndRoutingContracts
D-008.description: Projection and routing must be explicit contracts with guards, precedence, and conflict handling, not only narrative descriptions.

export-controlDecision.PURPOSE: Preserve formal control semantics for projection and routing.

D-009.name: SplitSyncSemantics
D-009.description: sync is a two-phase flow: canonical reconcile first, owned-only cleanup second.

export-syncDecision.PURPOSE: Preserve safe sync semantics by separating reconcile and cleanup.

D-010.name: ConservativeRuntimeDefaults
D-010.description: guided and single are the normative defaults, while auto, multi, and calibrate apply remain experimental until stronger guards and verification exist.

export-runtimeDecision.PURPOSE: Preserve conservative normative defaults while allowing guarded experimentation.

D-011.name: BootstrapProfilesShareOneMethodology
D-011.description: vibestart core and deep are product profiles over one VIBE methodology, not separate standards.

export-bootstrapDecision.PURPOSE: Preserve one methodology across both product profiles.

D-012.name: DeterministicFirstRunContract
D-012.description: vibestart must emit a deterministic first-run contract covering installed surfaces, defaults, optionals, and next-step behavior.

export-onboardingDecision.PURPOSE: Preserve explicit onboarding and first-run behavior.

D-013.name: EnglishContractMarkup
D-013.description: Canonical contract markup and structural labels remain in English for cross-agent and cross-runtime interoperability.

export-languageDecision.PURPOSE: Preserve English-only contract markup and structural labels.

D-014.name: GraceTechnologyCompatibilityShim
D-014.description: docs/technology.xml may exist to satisfy GRACE-compatible planning workflows, but it remains a compatibility shim rather than a canonical VIBE core artifact.

export-compatDecision.PURPOSE: Preserve the boundary between GRACE compatibility surfaces and VIBE core semantics.
